eips.title: Withdrawal credentials preregistration
eips.summary: Discussed as the basis for PQ pre-registration allowing withdrawal credentials to register without depositing 1 ETH.

moments.context: Terence raised the pre-registration mechanism that is in the PQ spec, where a message can be sent before a deposit, and the room identified it as EIP-8205.
Participants discussed the property EIP-8205 provides: enabling a free-of-charge pre-agreement before depositing ETH, removing the race condition with money at stake.
Walked through what EIP-8205 changes: instead of paying one ETH to make the initial registration, a separate contract lets you pre-register. The spec author noted he had modified it to fit PQ.
A participant recalled that the room had agreed to tackle this problem when EIP-8205 was DFI'd for Hegota, without recalling which ACD call that was.

Raised that some people had complained on the EIP wanting the operator to send these messages, so verifying BLS on the EL would let the operator send the pre-registration instead of the withdrawal credentials.

eips.title: Custom sweep threshold for validators
eips.summary: Barnabas proposed using EIP-8148 to only allow 0x02 validators and drop 0x01 and consolidations in PQ.

moments.context: Barnabas suggested doing EIP-8148 and only allowing 0x02 style validators, proposing to drop 0x00 and 0x01 credential types and remove consolidations as an option in PQ.
Dima Gusakov of Lido pointed at 8148 again in chat as something worth looking at, without the room taking it up.

eips.title: Post-Quantum Material Registration
eips.summary: Ethlambda reported having implemented EIP-8483 on top of Heze and tested LeanVM bindings.

moments.context: Mega from ethlambda stated they have tested LeanVM bindings and implemented EIP-8483 on top of Heze, planning to rebase on Glamsterdam and continue with the rest of the spec.
